import static android.app.WindowConfiguration.WINDOWING_MODE_FULLSCREEN;
import com.android.quickstep.GestureState.GestureEndTarget;
import com.android.quickstep.fallback.RoseEdgeGesture;
import com.android.quickstep.fallback.RoseEdgeSwipe;
import com.android.quickstep.util.TaskViewSimulator;
    // RoseOS (#410): the raised edge's release rules and live preview, off unless persist.wm.debug.rose_edge.
    private final RoseEdgeSwipe mRoseEdge;
    private final Matrix mRoseMatrix = new Matrix();
    private final Rect mRoseCrop = new Rect();
    private final float[] mRoseRadius = new float[1];
    private boolean mRoseAttached;
    private final BuilderProxy mRosePreview = (builder, app, params) -> builder.setMatrix(mRoseMatrix)
            .setWindowCrop(mRoseCrop).setCornerRadius(mRoseRadius[0]);

        mRoseEdge = new RoseEdgeSwipe(context, displayId, mGestureState.getTopRunningTaskId(),
                mGestureState.getSwipeUpStartTimeMs(), mDeviceState.getTouchSlop(),
                mRunningOverHome || mGestureState.isTrackpadGesture() || continuingLastGesture
                        || !isRoseFullscreenTask());
    /** RoseOS (#410): a short swipe Home over an app raises the edge instead (RoseEdgeGesture). */
    @Override
    protected GestureEndTarget refineEndTarget(
            GestureEndTarget endTarget, boolean isCancel, boolean isMotionPaused) {
        if (!mRoseEdge.enabled()) {
            return endTarget;
        }
        if (mGestureState.isHandlingAtomicEvent()) {
            mRoseEdge.settled(endTarget == GestureEndTarget.LAST_TASK);
            return endTarget;
        }
        GestureEndTarget refined = endTarget;
        switch (mRoseEdge.release(isRoseGestureNavigation(), isRoseNaturalRotation(), isCancel,
                isMotionPaused, endTarget == GestureEndTarget.HOME, mCurrentDisplacement)) {
            case RoseEdgeGesture.RAISE:
            case RoseEdgeGesture.STAY:
                refined = GestureEndTarget.LAST_TASK;
                break;
            case RoseEdgeGesture.HOME:
                refined = GestureEndTarget.HOME;
                break;
            default:
                break;
        }
        mRoseEdge.settled(refined == GestureEndTarget.LAST_TASK);
        return refined;
    }

    /**
     * RoseOS (#410): while the edge applies and the app has not attached to recents, the app's own leash is cropped at
     * full width (RoseEdgeSwipe.preview); otherwise Launcher3's transform as before.
     */
    @Override
    protected void applyTargetTransform(
            TaskViewSimulator taskViewSimulator, TransformParams transformParams) {
        if (!mRoseEdge.enabled()) {
            super.applyTargetTransform(taskViewSimulator, transformParams);
            return;
        }
        GestureEndTarget endTarget = mGestureState.getEndTarget();
        // Once the app attaches to recents it stays on Launcher3's transform for the rest of the gesture.
        mRoseAttached |= hasAttachedToRecents() || endTarget == GestureEndTarget.RECENTS
                || endTarget == GestureEndTarget.NEW_TASK;
        if (mDp == null || !mRoseEdge.preview(isRoseGestureNavigation(), isRoseNaturalRotation(), mRoseAttached,
                mCurrentShift.value * mTransitionDragLength, mDp.getDeviceProperties().getWidthPx(),
                mDp.getDeviceProperties().getHeightPx(), mRoseMatrix, mRoseCrop, mRoseRadius)) {
            super.applyTargetTransform(taskViewSimulator, transformParams);
            return;
        }
        transformParams.applySurfaceParams(transformParams.createSurfaceParams(mRosePreview));
    }

    private boolean isRoseGestureNavigation() {
        return mDp != null && mDp.getDeviceProperties().getDeviceConfiguration().isGestureMode();
    }

    private boolean isRoseFullscreenTask() {
        TaskInfo task = mGestureState.getRunningTask() != null
                ? mGestureState.getRunningTask().getLegacyBaseTask() : null;
        return task != null && task.getWindowingMode() == WINDOWING_MODE_FULLSCREEN;
    }

    private boolean isRoseNaturalRotation() {
        return mRemoteTargetHandles != null && mRemoteTargetHandles.length == 1
                && mRemoteTargetHandles[0].getTaskViewSimulator().getOrientationState()
                        .getDisplayRotation() == Surface.ROTATION_0;
    }
